这条路线把需要认真阅读的古代展品，与可以慢慢走的花园放在同一天。Rosicruc: Pair ancient objects that reward close reading with an unhurried garden walk. The Rosicrucian Egyptian Museum and Municipal Rose Garden are separate locations. Give the museum sufficient time before walking through the neighborhood to the garden. Rose blooms vary by season, and the garden also makes a pleasant place for a short rest.
先定博物馆，再安排花园: Plan the museum first, then the garden
费用：博物馆需门票，市立玫瑰园普通散步免费；餐饮与交通另算，购票前阅读退改规则。: Cost: the museum requires admission; ordinary visits to the Municipal Rose Garden are free. Food and transport are separate. Read ticket cancellation and change rules before buying.
时长：建议合计 3–4 小时，含馆内参观、街区转场和花园短走；想细读展品可只逛博: Duration: allow 3–4 hours for the museum, neighborhood transfer and a short garden walk. Visit only the museum if you prefer to read exhibits in depth.
到达：博物馆入口地址为 1660 Park Ave，停车位置在其他街侧；先查施工: Arrival: the museum entrance is at 1660 Park Ave, with parking on other sides of the block. Check the construction map first; transit arrivals still require a walk.
行动需求：展厅分多层，馆方有轮椅升降平台，但明确不允许婴儿推车使用；轮椅尺寸和协: Mobility: galleries span multiple levels. A wheelchair platform lift is available but explicitly cannot carry strollers. Confirm wheelchair fit and assistance in advance.
从古代生活走到街区花园: From ancient life to a neighborhood garden
博物馆、园区出口与玫瑰园: Museum, park exit and rose garden
前两站在博物馆及其园区，第三站需另走街区道路；以开放路径和过街信号为准。: The first two stops are at the museum and its grounds. The third requires a separate neighborhood walk; follow open paths and crossing signals.
第一站：埃及博物馆慢看展: Stop 1: an unhurried Egyptian Museum visit
入馆先取导览并确认各层通行方式，把注意力放在日常生活、文字或信仰中的一个主题。带: Collect a guide and confirm access between levels, then focus on daily life, writing or beliefs. Explain to children that displays include funerary culture and let them skip anything uncomfortable. Leave space around objects, follow photography rules and avoid rushing to reach the next stop.
第二站：Rosicrucian Park 出口休整: Stop 2: pause near the Rosicrucian Park exit
离开展厅后在园区允许通行的区域缓一缓，核对下一站的街道方向、过街位置和剩余体力。: Pause in an accessible open area after leaving the galleries and check directions, crossings and everyone's energy. Construction may change parking and pedestrian routes; follow the marked detours. This is a good place to finish if companions are tired, without continuing to the garden merely to complete the route.
导航市立玫瑰园的 Naglee Ave 与 Dana Ave 一带入口，沿街区人: Navigate to the Municipal Rose Garden entrance near Naglee and Dana Avenues, using sidewalks and designated crossings. Compare flower shapes and colors from marked paths, staying out of beds and maintenance areas. Even outside peak bloom, pause in the shade and plan your return to your car or transit stop.
推车、天气和返程都单独考虑: Plan strollers, weather and the return trip separately
带幼儿先和馆方确认推车存放与楼层安排，不能把轮椅升降平台当作推车电梯。需要平缓路: Families with young children should ask about stroller storage and access between levels; the wheelchair lift cannot be used as a stroller elevator. Shorten the neighborhood walk or arrange pickup for those needing easier routes. Keep indoor exhibits in rain and shorten the garden walk in heat, bringing water. Check parking restrictions before returning to your car, since museum and garden hours differ.
